title: Verifying a Multi-File Agentic Change
objective: Run an agentic session that changes at least three files toward one feature, then verify the whole change holistically, including how the changed pieces interact, not each file in isolation.
whyThisMatters: Multi-file agentic changes can be locally reasonable and globally wrong — an interface changed in one file, a caller not updated in another. The verification skill here is catching that class of failure.
evidence: The plan or scoping prompt given to the assistant, committed before the session, naming the files expected to change
The resulting diff across all changed files
An integration-level test or documented manual walkthrough exercising the interaction between at least two of the changed files, run and shown passing
A note on any file changed that was not in the original plan, and why
AI disclosure entry naming the tool/model used, purpose, and what was independently verified
acceptanceCriteria: The diff touches three or more files.
An integration-level check exists that exercises at least two changed files together, not only unit tests of each file in isolation.
The integration-level check is shown passing against the final change.
Any out-of-plan file change is explicitly noted and justified.
